ios.desc:
Explore 500+ cards with distilled knowledge and insights from tech professionals. Keep up to date with the latest tech news and stories and stay sharp without spam, ads, or other distractions. Collaborate for mutual growth, and share your firsthand experience to empower the tech community members. Ride the information tide together, and shape the space where skills and knowledge take priority.

NO DISTRACTIONS: forget about noisy ads popping up on your screen. We erased all the distractions, so you can focus on what matters.

BITE-SIZED CONTENT: explore and create concise cards with tech news, stories, and insights. With deks, you get everything you need to know about the world of tech at a glance.

GO BEYOND THE BASICS : learn best practices, valuable insights, and the ins and outs of tech jobs from experts. Become a thought leader by offering a comprehensive, unique, and impactful view of your area of expertise.

STAY SHARP: explore what’s trending in the world of tech and keep your professional skills honed.

VARIETY OF TOPICS: tech, product management, software development, marketing, design, web3, startups (building, promoting, financing, and growing from zero to hero)… this is only the beginning. 

If you have any questions or suggestions on how we can improve the application, please do not hesitate to contact us at hello@deks.app

quotes.text:
Hi!

We're working on a mobile app called deks.

It's a shortform content platform for tech professionals and entrepreneurs, with a twist — every story is distilled to a few short cards (under 500 characters each), designed to be read in seconds.

The app on iOS devices: https://apps.apple.com/app/apple-store/id1638375444

We want to focus on two types of content for now:

- news and articles about the tech industry, created by our editorial team and guest contributors. Think of it as your daily TL;DR for everything that matters in tech.

- networking. Users are encouraged to tell about their work, share insights, post job listings or announce new features.

We hope to help users cut through the noise thanks to the short form nature of our content, but also enable them to share their ideas as effortlessly as possible.

Here's a small demo: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tSxE669iOG0

More info is available on our website: http://deks.app or join our Discord: https://discord.gg/zcW7QNNs6E
